stayInRuntime.description:
If false, then we force execution to occur server-side. Otherwise, we allow it to occur in the current runtime.
Doesn't have any effect on asynchronous execution.

executor.description: Field to pick an executor for the workflow to be executed. Executes outer workflow.

synchronousExecutorRequirement.description:
Only applicable for {@link #executor} "synchronous". If provided, this will run the
executor in the specified runtime.

runAsUser.description:
If true, the Workflow vertices will be run as the
user who started the workflow. If false, then they will be run as worker.
